verdict.rationale: LibreChat ships its own Agent Management API, currently in beta. It supports create, discover, update and delete operations on Agents, management of agent files and Skills, and machine-client authentication via deployment-bound OIDC identities. An OpenAPI spec is published at librechat.ai/openapi.json, so a documented programmatic surface exists. However, the API is beta, and the evidence covers only agent management, not running conversations or the broader product. missing for 10: stable (non-beta) API status, evidence of API coverage for sending chats/conversations and other core features, in-depth API reference content, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
